diagnostic.purpose: Measure whether the diagnostic HUD itself changes frame interval on the river/village map. No renderer optimization claim.
diagnostic.map: old sym9 village/river map from immutable Perspective/Tex3 parent: maps/kordos/kordos.3d, baked kordod.vla, Tex3 slots forest/map-selo1/river
diagnostic.renderer: immutable parent StaticRoomPerspectiveMesh/Stats class bytes retained; GRID4x4, perspective ON

hud_modes.key1: FULL: six lines on 90px panel, drawn every frame
hud_modes.key3: MIN: heading + N/C/I on 30px panel, drawn every frame
hud_modes.key0: OFF: no panel/text after map Image copy; stats still collected
hud_modes.star: in OFF, freeze and show last completed FULL result; press star again to resume with fresh warmup

diagnostic.key5: home; preserves selected HUD mode, resets stats
diagnostic.pump: same parent worker repaint()+serviceRepaints()+sleep(1) in all HUD modes; not FramePump SELF/S0
diagnostic.depth: ON; river depth write OFF as in parent materials
diagnostic.perspective: ON (fixed; no ON/OFF toggle in this HUD diagnostic)
diagnostic.river: all 4 cached frames, speed6, mode7, UV/order unchanged
diagnostic.stats_note: StaticRoomPerspectiveStats wall-clock API timings, NOT GPU timestamps or proven LCD flips

purpose: Isolated river-map HUD FULL/MIN/OFF A/B over immutable Perspective release; map/renderer/pump unchanged.
